title: Lights around Ellsworth nuclear sites before the abduction
place_text: Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I just see lights out in out there around the nuclear sites and everything.

plain: In 1977, in the missile field of Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, an Air Force veteran named Michael Johnson says he saw lights around the nuclear missile sites shortly before what he describes as his abduction. He tells it firsthand: "I just see lights out there around the nuclear sites." If true, something unexplained was hovering near American nuclear weapons.
